title: QA: Guard awareness
eyebrow: Hand test for issue #479 (steps #480 to #489) on AjsAgent/guard-deep-dive-0031e3, with before and after co-op recordings

unverified: Nobody has played the new guards by hand yet.
My recordings show only the host's camera, which mostly faces a wall, so the clips show less than the logs do. Play it yourself to judge.
In the floor-hole run after the changes, the guard ran off to a place it remembered from the previous scenario, so that case is not shown working.
A guard hunting a player it has lost stops after 40 quiet seconds, even when it is close. I chose that cap; it is not in the design.
Three stair-climbing guard tests (GuardClimbsTheStairToItsGallery) failed before this work and still fail.

short.lead: Every guard pick you approved is built and pushed, and all 569 play-mode tests pass. I recorded the five playtest scenarios in co-op, before and after the changes. Each item shows both. The logs say more than the pictures, so the sentence under each item is what the log recorded.
short.hint: Run the command in the Start item to open the gym, then try each item.
items: Open the Ophan Gym in co-op

In Git Bash, from C:\Users\aj\Desktop\GameDev\PlunderSpell\.claude\worktrees\guard-deep-dive-0031e3, run: bash Tools/Unity/coop_local.sh --gym. You should see "Co-op on this PC is up". F8 stops damage to you; F9 removes the guards.
Run it once; every item below uses this session.
A guard 2 m beside you sees you
Before: the guard stood 2 m to your side and never noticed you. After: it saw you within a second and attacked (it entered the Combat state at 1.0 s). Walk up beside a guard at a wall.

items.alt: Four frames of the after run, beside scenario
items.caption: After. Before: ../generated/guard-awareness-qa/beside-before.jpg; clips beside-before.mp4 and beside-after.mp4.

items: A guard at a checked spot looks round

Before: the guard walked to the spot and stared at the wall. After: it turned, found you 9 m behind it, chased you and fought you (states: Combat at 1.0 s, then Chase, then Investigate when it lost you). Make a noise, then stand behind where the guard will stop.
Say whether it looks round enough.

items.alt: Four frames of the after run, spot scenario
items.caption: After. Before: spot-before.jpg; clips spot-before.mp4 and spot-after.mp4.

items: A chase broken off behind cover

Before: the guard gave up within 1.4 s and went back to patrol. After: I hid you 20 m away, out of its sight. The guard went to where it last saw you, found you, and fought you for 10 more seconds. Break line of sight and run a room or two.
Say whether it hunts long enough, or too long.

items.alt: Four frames of the after run, pillar scenario
items.caption: After. Before: pillar-before.jpg; clips pillar-before.mp4 and pillar-after.mp4.

items: Three melee guards on one player
Before: the three guards took turns, with one swinging at a time. After: two swing at once and the third waits. Guards also chase at 5.5 m/s. Let three guards reach you.
Say whether that is too much.

items.alt: Four frames of the after run, trio scenario
items.caption: After. Before: trio-before.jpg; clips trio-before.mp4 and trio-after.mp4.

items: A guard and you either side of a beam hole

Before: the guard walked round the hole and reached you in 7 s. After: the run was inconclusive, because the guard went to a spot it was already checking instead. Press F7 to have the Ophan break a floor, then stand across the hole from a guard.
Say whether it goes round, or holds and throws.

changes: When there is no route to you, the guard takes the long way round, or holds below and throws.
ChaseState, InvestigateState, GuardNearestReachableWalk; HoldBelow now steps back into view.
Only castle stone blocks sight. The vision cone has three layers. Calm range is 31.5 m.
Guards turn toward sounds, look round, hear through doorways, and hear at 1.5 times the range.
The guard goes back to patrol only after 8 quiet seconds, and only once your last-known spot is 3 rooms from it.
Chase speed is 5.5 m/s, the alarm speed bonus applies to every move, and two melee swings can happen at once.
GuardTuning, GuardNavigator, AttackTurnTuning, prefabs and scenes.
